title: Sharing in a Ratio
summary: A recap lesson, built around the mistakes: sharing a total, a known share and a given difference in a ratio of two or three parts. Every section runs a Depth card (who is right?), a worked bar model that fills in click by click, five authored whiteboard questions and the tool's live generator, then an independent set: a 3 × 3 board grid for sharing a total and one printed book sheet (two A4 pages, four lettered parts) that carries the same questions plus the known share, the difference and a mixed set of fifteen, with its answers on a click at the end of each part.

els.text: Share an amount in a ratio of two or three parts, and use a known share or a difference to find the shares and the total.

•  Share a total in a ratio
•  Use a known share or a difference to find one part
•  Check that the shares add to the total

question: Amy and Bo share £88 in the ratio $3:5$
Find both shares.
explanation:
Bar model: draw a box for each part of the ratio.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Amy","units":3},{"name":"Bo","units":5}]}
Add the parts to find the total: 8 parts.

Value of 1 part: £88 ÷ 8 = £11.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Amy","units":3,"unitLabel":"£11"},{"name":"Bo","units":5,"unitLabel":"£11"}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Amy","units":3,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£33"},{"name":"Bo","units":5,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£55"}]}
Check: £33 + £55 = £88, the total shared.

slides.title: A known share

question: Kim and Lou share money in the ratio $3:4$
Kim receives £33
What is the total amount shared?
explanation:
Given information: mark the known share on the bar model.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Kim","units":3,"known":true,"given":true,"total":"£33"},{"name":"Lou","units":4}]}
Identify the ratio part: Kim has 3 parts.

Value of 1 part: £33 ÷ 3 = £11.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Kim","units":3,"unitLabel":"£11","known":true,"given":true,"total":"£33"},{"name":"Lou","units":4,"unitLabel":"£11"}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Kim","units":3,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£33"},{"name":"Lou","units":4,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£44"}]}
Add all the shares to find the total: £33 + £44 = £77.
Check: £33 : £44 ÷ £11 = 3 : 4, the ratio given.

@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Max","units":2,"unitLabel":"£8","total":"£16"},{"name":"Nell","units":5,"unitLabel":"£8","total":"£40"}]}
Read Max's share from the bar: £16.
Check: £16 : £40 ÷ £8 = 2 : 5, the ratio given.

question: Amy and Bo share money in the ratio $3:5$
Bo receives £14 more than Amy
How much does Amy receive?
explanation:
Bar model: the extra boxes show the difference.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Amy","units":3},{"name":"Bo","units":5,"extraFrom":3}]}
The difference represents 2 parts = £14.

Value of 1 part: £14 ÷ 2 = £7.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Amy","units":3,"unitLabel":"£7"},{"name":"Bo","units":5,"unitLabel":"£7","extraFrom":3}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Amy","units":3,"unitLabel":"£7","total":"£21"},{"name":"Bo","units":5,"unitLabel":"£7","total":"£35"}]}
Read Amy's share from the bar: £21.
Check: £35 − £21 = £14, the difference given.

explanation:

Value of 1 part: £36 ÷ 3 = £12.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Cara","units":2,"unitLabel":"£12"},{"name":"Dan","units":5,"unitLabel":"£12","extraFrom":2}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Cara","units":2,"unitLabel":"£12","total":"£24"},{"name":"Dan","units":5,"unitLabel":"£12","total":"£60"}]}
Add all the shares to find the total: £24 + £60 = £84.
Check: £60 − £24 = £36, the difference given.

question: Kim and Lou share £132 in the ratio $5:7$
How much does Lou receive?
explanation:
Bar model: draw a box for each part of the ratio.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Kim","units":5},{"name":"Lou","units":7}]}
Add the parts to find the total: 12 parts.

Value of 1 part: £132 ÷ 12 = £11.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Kim","units":5,"unitLabel":"£11"},{"name":"Lou","units":7,"unitLabel":"£11"}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Kim","units":5,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£55"},{"name":"Lou","units":7,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£77"}]}
Check: £55 + £77 = £132, the total shared.

question: Max and Nell share money in the ratio $3:8$
Nell receives £72
What is the total amount shared?
explanation:
Given information: mark the known share on the bar model.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Max","units":3},{"name":"Nell","units":8,"known":true,"given":true,"total":"£72"}]}
Identify the ratio part: Nell has 8 parts.

Value of 1 part: £72 ÷ 8 = £9.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Max","units":3,"unitLabel":"£9"},{"name":"Nell","units":8,"unitLabel":"£9","known":true,"given":true,"total":"£72"}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Max","units":3,"unitLabel":"£9","total":"£27"},{"name":"Nell","units":8,"unitLabel":"£9","total":"£72"}]}
Add all the shares to find the total: £27 + £72 = £99.
Check: £27 : £72 ÷ £9 = 3 : 8, the ratio given.

question: Orla and Pip share money in the ratio $3:7$
Pip receives £28 more than Orla
How much does Orla receive?
explanation:
Bar model: the extra boxes show the difference.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Orla","units":3},{"name":"Pip","units":7,"extraFrom":3}]}
The difference represents 4 parts = £28.

Value of 1 part: £28 ÷ 4 = £7.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Orla","units":3,"unitLabel":"£7"},{"name":"Pip","units":7,"unitLabel":"£7","extraFrom":3}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Orla","units":3,"unitLabel":"£7","total":"£21"},{"name":"Pip","units":7,"unitLabel":"£7","total":"£49"}]}
Read Orla's share from the bar: £21.
Check: £49 − £21 = £28, the difference given.

question: Del, Eli and Fay share £110 in the ratio $2:3:5$
How much does Del receive?
explanation:
Bar model: draw a box for each part of the ratio.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Del","units":2},{"name":"Eli","units":3},{"name":"Fay","units":5}]}
Add the parts to find the total: 10 parts.

Value of 1 part: £110 ÷ 10 = £11.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Del","units":2,"unitLabel":"£11"},{"name":"Eli","units":3,"unitLabel":"£11"},{"name":"Fay","units":5,"unitLabel":"£11"}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Del","units":2,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£22"},{"name":"Eli","units":3,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£33"},{"name":"Fay","units":5,"unitLabel":"£11","total":"£55"}]}
Check: £22 + £33 + £55 = £110, the total shared.

question: Gus, Hui and Isa share money in the ratio $3:4:5$
Isa receives £45
How much does Hui receive?
explanation:
Given information: mark the known share on the bar model.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Gus","units":3},{"name":"Hui","units":4},{"name":"Isa","units":5,"known":true,"given":true,"total":"£45"}]}
Identify the ratio part: Isa has 5 parts.

Value of 1 part: £45 ÷ 5 = £9.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Gus","units":3,"unitLabel":"£9"},{"name":"Hui","units":4,"unitLabel":"£9"},{"name":"Isa","units":5,"unitLabel":"£9","known":true,"given":true,"total":"£45"}]}

Calculate each share: the value of 1 part × the number of parts.
@bar {"parts":[],"rows":[{"name":"Gus","units":3,"unitLabel":"£9","total":"£27"},{"name":"Hui","units":4,"unitLabel":"£9","total":"£36"},{"name":"Isa","units":5,"unitLabel":"£9","total":"£45"}]}
Read Hui's share from the bar: £36.
Check: £27 : £36 : £45 ÷ £9 = 3 : 4 : 5, the ratio given.
